title: Care Kit
short: A modular home-care kit designed for confidence and clarity.
intro: A family of objects that helps people follow a treatment routine without making the home feel clinical.
hero: A modular system that makes the next action obvious.

sections.title: The hardest part is often remembering the next step.
sections.body: Care Kit uses visible states, consistent grips and a compact footprint to support routines that happen under stress or fatigue.

sections.title: One family, different levels of support.
sections.body: The system shares a visual language across storage, dosing and cleaning components, so the user can recognise the right object without reading every label.

sections.title: Clarity is a physical feature.
sections.body: Early models focused on reach, orientation and hand strength. The form changed as the interaction became more important than the original visual idea.
